curation.notes: Mainly a cell-biology/photocatalysis study; the SMFS component is custom magnetic tweezers repetitive force scanning (1–50–1 pN) of DNA-handled E. coli GlpG intramembrane protease in DMPC/CHAPSO bicelles, before and after injection of the amphiphilic photocatalyst BTP under blue-light illumination, to measure oxidative destabilisation of membrane protein folding.

entities.name: GlpG intramembrane rhomboid protease in DMPC/CHAPSO bicelles

evidence.snippet: The pTrcHisA vector containing the gene for E. coli GlpG membrane protein was transformed into BL21-Gold (DE3) pLysS (Agilent)30.
Sample preparation of DNA-handled GlpG and a robust single-molecule system assembly for the force application was previously reported57,58.
The lipid bilayer environment for the membrane protein was reconstituted with a bicelle nanostructure, a lipid bilayer disc composed of DMPC lipid and CHAPSO detergent at a 2.5:1 molar ratio.

small_molecules.name: BTP (amphiphilic photocatalyst), with 450 nm blue light
